fixes.explanation: True, baker! Jesus says, “…and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.” Beam out first, then clear sight. So He isn't telling anyone to stop helping. He's saying to get your own eye sorted out before you go digging in somebody else's.

True, baker. Jesus says, “I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!” The name for them and the command to depart are both right there in verse 23. Just before that, He says that not everyone who says “Lord, Lord” will enter the kingdom of heaven (Matthew 7:21).

Astonished, baker! The Gospel of Matthew says the crowds “…were astonished at His teaching…” That's quite a reaction after a long sermon. The next verse says why: He taught as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.
